answer: Reaching the reef of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. A garden of per-task receipts records who did what, and the echo of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, diluted when peers disagree, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
